test_title: RRB NTPC (UG) CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 19 Aug, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Read the given statements and conclusions carefully. Assuming that the information given in the statements is true, even if it appears to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the given conclusions logically follow(s) from the statements.

Statements:

All chisels are hammers.

No hammer is a maize.

Conclusions

(I): No chisel is a maize. 

(II): Some maize are hammers.
solution:
The least possible venn diagram is shown below,

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/5076ea05e1e39a510dd50fc59b4c1bf6f8b6b57dcb75cc7016edd6ac3e85eaf8.png] 

Conclusions (I): No chisel is a maize. - True (No hammer is a maize and chisel is a Hammer so, no chisel is a maize" is true.)

Conclusions (II): Some maize are hammers. - False (No hammer is a maize,so Some maize are hammers is a false)

Only conclusion (I) follows.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 3"**
